description:
Did you know that an octopus has three hearts, blue blood, and a brain in each of its eight arms? In this 35-minute deep-sea documentary, we explore the mysterious world of one of Earth's most intelligent and "alien-like" creatures. From their incredible camouflage skills to their tragic life cycle, discover why the octopus is a true masterpiece of nature.

In this video, we dive deep into:

The 'Alien' Connection: Why their genome is unlike any other creature on Earth.

Anatomy of a Genius: How their three hearts, blue blood, and rectangular pupils work.

The Master of Disguise: The science behind their instant color and texture changes.

Intelligence & Tools: Stories of octopuses solving puzzles and using tools.

Defense Mechanisms: The truth about their ink clouds and the legendary 'Kraken'.
